comparison.objective: Replace a butterfly safety-razor blade and close it over locating posts.
comparison.physical_skill: Edge-only blade grasping, alignment over posts, placement, and razor closure.
comparison.success_condition: The new blade sits on the posts beneath closed doors and is released; detailed tolerances and damage criteria are absent.
comparison.reason: This tests delicate planar alignment and closure, not bimanual hammering, controlled notch fracture, or recovery of free fragments.
